finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (found at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, folder "Bench") contains exactly 3 panels, titled exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled `fwgr43-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved (version 4 at final check). It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr43-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (`grafana-testdata-datasource`). Verified on the live dashboard view after a fresh reload; the Stat panel rendered a value (87.8 at one check, 27.6 at the final check — test data varies).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr43-n1 Notes` with content `Bench run fwgr43-n1 notes`, which includes the runid `fwgr43-n1`. Saved and verified after reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (confirmed as a tag chip in Dashboard settings → General and as `tags: ["bench"]` in the saved JSON Model). The time range is `Last 6 hours` and it was persisted into the saved dashboard — the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox was ticked at save time, and the saved JSON Model shows `"time": {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is `1m`. It was persisted by ticking the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox; the saved JSON Model shows `"refresh": "1m"`, and after a fresh reload the top-bar refresh picker shows `1m` (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar on a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfyenn3aflqf4c/fwgr43-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `bfyenn3aflqf4c`

Notes: This Grafana build's panel editor has no separate "Apply" button (only "Back to dashboard / Discard panel / Save dashboard"), so panel edits were committed via Back to dashboard followed by an explicit dashboard save. All persistence was confirmed through the saved JSON Model (version 4, schemaVersion 40) and a final read-only fresh reload.
